about: Golden vectors for SUDARSHAN market alerts (M10): the contract between the pure engine in
sudarshan/alerts/market and anything else that must decide the same thing, such as the Alerts
form's level snapping (the snap group). test_market_vectors.py runs every case.
Times are IST on the defaults' day unless a step names its own day. A trade step's ltt is its
'at' unless given; 'recv' (arrival) is 'at' unless given; 'NaN' and 'Infinity' are strings so
JSON.parse can read the file. Prices in expectations are text with the instrument's decimals.
The calendar is the vectors' own: weekdays trade except its holidays, and a day in its
windows trades in that window (the extra-days file's line, e.g. 2026-11-08 14:05-15:40).
Alert steps: a trade or quote, {clock}, {pause: [from, to]} (the feed reconnecting),
{restart: [from, to]} (the service down; only market.db's fields survive), {suspend},
{resume}, {edit: fields}, {seed: snapshot tick}. A step's 'check' is the gate's verdict.
Words: a fire's golden texts, the app's title and detail and the Telegram line; prices in a
fire are text and the times IST on the defaults' day.
